response.original_title: Captain Jack and His Rocket Powered Go-Kart
response.overview: Less than 2" off the ground, 90 plus year old Captain Jack, along with the Rocketboys, defy death by bringing back the very same hydrogen peroxide rocket go-kart he raced fifty years ago. With appearance from Brian Lohnes and Don Garlits.
response.title: Captain Jack and His Rocket Powered Go-Kart
